candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether control-mechanism provisions are treated as enforceable limits affects which numeric limits are eligible for compliance comparison versus report-only or non-operative text.

candidates.exact_span: Effluent limits, including Best Management Practices, based on applicable general Pretreatment Standards, categorical Pretreatment Standards, local limits, and State and local law
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of which standards and local law sources govern effluent limits, and whether BMPs count as numeric effluent limits, could change which enforceable limit applies to a parameter and whether a measurement can be compared numerically.

candidates.exact_span: Statement of applicable civil and criminal penalties for violation of Pretreatment Standards and requirements, and any applicable compliance schedule. Such schedules may not extend the compliance date beyond federal deadlines
candidates.computation_change_reason: If an applicable compliance schedule is present, its interim limits and deadlines could determine which enforceable numeric limit applies during Federal FY2025 rather than the final standard alone.

candidates.exact_span: Self-monitoring, sampling, reporting, notification and recordkeeping requirements, including an identification of the pollutants to be monitored
candidates.computation_change_reason: This clause defines the monitoring obligations that control mechanisms must contain; interpreting which pollutants and reporting duties are required changes whether monitoring was applicable for a given parameter and period.

candidates.exact_span: the process for seeking a waiver for a pollutant neither present nor expected to be present in the Discharge on accordance with § 403.12(e)(2)
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a §403.12(e)(2) waiver was or could be obtained affects whether monitoring was required at all (B) and whether a missing result reflects conditional monitoring not required versus inadequate evidence (C).

candidates.computation_change_reason: The corrupted or ambiguous waiver phrase could be read as a distinct individual-mechanism waiver pathway; different interpretations could change whether monitoring was waived and how missing-data cases are classified.

candidates.exact_span: sampling location, sampling frequency, and sample type, based on the applicable general Pretreatment Standards in 40 CFR 403, categorical Pretreatment Standards, local limits, and State and local law
candidates.computation_change_reason: How sampling location, frequency, and sample type are derived from referenced standards affects whether monitoring was required for a given period, season, or event condition.

candidates.exact_span: Requirements to control slug discharges, if determined by the POTW to be necessary
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the POTW determined slug-discharge controls necessary is a conditional trigger; different readings change whether related monitoring or control obligations were applicable and how absent results are characterized.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall evaluate, whether each Significant Industrial User needs a plan or other action to control slug discharges, in accordance with 40 CFR 403.8(f)(2)(vi)
candidates.computation_change_reason: The outcome of SIU-specific slug-discharge evaluations could impose additional monitoring or action requirements that depend on facility-level determinations rather than uniform permit text.
